maddeler.e:
تلتقطوا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَقِطُوا (taltaqiṭū) /tal.ta.qi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# تُلْتَقَطُوا (tultaqaṭū) /tul.ta.qa.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
